Name: DE-Estimates
Statement:
with
tag as
(
    select  Oid as EstimateId,
            string_agg(tag.Label, ', ') as Tags
    from    Estimate
                cross apply openjson(TagsJson) with (Label nvarchar(255) '$.Label') as tag
    group by Oid
)
select	est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.Number + ' - ' + est.Name as Estimate,
        est.Number as EstimateNumber,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        est.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        typ.Oid as TypeId,
        typ.Name as Type,
        est.Client as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        cnt.Number + ' - ' + cnt.Name as Contract,
        est.Project as ProjectId,
        prj.Number + ' - ' + prj.Name as Project,
        est.Product as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        est.Currency as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        est.Exchange as Exchange,
        est.Date as StartDate,
        est.Expiration as EndDate,
        rtc.Oid as RateCardId,
        rtc.Name as RateCard,
        rcc.Oid as RateCardColumnId,
        rcc.Name as RateCardColumn,
        tag.Tags,
        est.ValueWithoutVatCost as ValueWithoutTaxCost,
        est.VatValueCost as TaxValueCost,
        est.ValueWithVatCost as ValueWithTaxCost,
        est.ValueWithoutVatIncome as ValueWithoutTaxSell,
        est.VatValueIncome as TaxValueSell,
        est.ValueWithVatIncome as ValueWithTaxSell
from 	Estimate est
            join JobType typ on typ.Oid = est.JobType
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join CommercialClient cli on cli.Oid = est.Client
            left join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = est.Project
            left join ContractLookup cnt on cnt.Id = est.Contract
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = est.Product
            join Currency cur on cur.Oid = est.Currency
            left join RateCard rtc on rtc.Oid = est.RateCard
            left join RateCardColumn rcc on rcc.Oid = est.RateCardColumn
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = est.Department
            left join tag on tag.EstimateId = est.Oid
where	wst.Status not in (1, 7)
